description: Cross-jurisdictional PD-status conflict resolution per work. Captures cases where a work is PD in some jurisdictions but not others (most common: URAA §104A restoration in US for foreign works; CC vs CA pre-2022 deltas; JP pre-2018 vs post-2018 TPP term extension). Pessimistic algorithm REJECTS any work failing PD in even one of 7 required jurisdictions; this Lexicon records the rejection reasoning + future eligibility year.

hasConflict.description: true if PD status differs across jurisdictions; false = no conflict (rare cross-juris harmony for ≥70-yr-old works)

conflictJurisdictions.description: ISO-3 codes of jurisdictions where work is NOT PD (subset of {USA, EUR, GBR, JPN, AUS, CAN, CHN})

conflictReasonExplanationCid.description: IPFS CID of detailed explanation document; cites specific copyright statute/treaty

resolutionVerdict.description: REJECT-pessimistic = default (most cases); ADMIT-pre/post-conflict only after conflict expires across all 7 jurisdictions

futureEligibilityYear.description: Estimated year when work becomes PD in ALL jurisdictions (after URAA expiry / CA/JP extension expiry / etc.); for re-evaluation queue

reEvaluationQueueAttested.description: true if work added to e7m-dataset re-evaluation queue for futureEligibilityYear

publicDomainStatusAttestationCid.description: Cross-reference to the publicDomainStatusAttestation that captured this conflict
